request: Implement an offline integration for the pinned GitHub PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/topics JSON body and 200 topic response. Publish request and response validators plus consumer mapping with output schema. Both payloads are objects requiring names: an array of strings; empty arrays are valid; null, absent names, nonstrings and nonarray names are invalid. Unknown properties are allowed per the pinned OpenAPI default. Map a valid response to exactly {topics: names}, preserving order, duplicates and case; no extra fields. The mapping output schema requires topics array of strings and forbids other fields. The server documentation says names are saved lowercase: this offline consumer does not emulate normalization or verify a server. Request validators validate documented shape, not an invented lexical topic policy. Mapping is only promised on valid response inputs, at most 128 names, bounded payloads. OpenAPI 3.0.3 adaptation: annotations/examples removed, required lists preserved, absent nullable means null forbidden here; no readOnly/writeOnly occur in the selected body/topic schemas. No unreviewed general OpenAPI conversion. This is benchmark-authored client work, not a historical GitHub change.

units.description: Define a reusable topic-name array schema, preserving empty arrays, order and duplicate string values.
